comparisons.name: hough_3d_default_distance_weight_hough_voting

baseline.checksum_policy: FNV-style checksum over generated scene vote coordinates
baseline.timer_boundary: Hough3DGrouping::houghVoting production boundary with use_interpolation=true and use_distance_weight=false; includes scene vote generation, HoughSpace construction, and voteInt scatter; excludes findMaxima and RANSAC filtering.
baseline.gate: PointXYZ / ReferenceFrame production instantiation; RVV build must hit the houghVoting vote-generation RVV path; distance weighting disabled to match the class default.
baseline.reduction: scene vote xyz generation with scalar min/max finalization
